title: Moff Gideon
description: An impressive Imperial Moff in the reign of the Empire, Moff Gideon worked in the shadows during the time of the New Republic to bring about a renewed age of the Empire. After reducing Mandalore to ash during the Night of a Thousand Tears, he turned it into his own personal base where he worked to create a new super army capable of taking back the galaxy from the New Republic. Seeking young Grogu out to harvest his blood, he wanted to make his army Force sensitive and unstoppable.
